name: incercam
description: Production window configurator with selectable GLB/USDZ export, Netlify upload tickets, Supabase Storage, Android Scene Viewer, and Apple AR Quick Look.

scripts.check: node --check src/server/server.js && node --check scripts/build/prepare_static_site.js && node --check src/client/ar-export.js && node --check cad/tools/convert.js && node --check cad/tools/test_convert.js && node --check netlify/functions/ar-upload-ticket.mjs && node --check shared-ui/src/standaloneShell.js && node --check shared-ui/src/components/topBar.js && node --check src/client/shared-shell.js && node --check roof-configurator/js/sharedShell.js
scripts.deploy:netlify: npm run prepare:static && npx --yes netlify-cli@latest deploy --prod --dir=dist/site --functions=netlify/functions
